info.name: Action (Matter) Bill Settings Action Bill Settings ActionTypes API

description.content: For retrieving Action Bill Settings. For historical reasons Matters are referred to as *actions* in this version of the API. For information of how to construct requests utilising fieldsets, sorting, paging, filters, and '*includes*', please refer to the API Developer Portal. E&OE.
